newsitem.title: UK: EMI shares gain as levels squeezed higher.
newsitem.headline: EMI shares gain as levels squeezed higher.

text.p: Shares in British music company EMI Group Plc gained on Monday after a large trade on Friday above the prevailing market price squeezed levels, traders said.
EMI shares were up 25 pence to 1,198 pence at 1027 GMT, after touching a high of 1,204 pence.
"There was a large trade on Friday night and the shares are reacting to that," one trader said.
A trade of some 300,000 shares was made late on Friday at 1,183 pence per share, higher than the prevailing market price.
Traders said that had helped to squeeze prices higher on Monday.
"There's no special news on the stock, buyers are in pretty small volumes," the trader added.
